title: Fantasy Map Generator: free Inkarnate alternative
caption:
Inkarnate's Creator plan costs $39.99/year to make fantasy maps. This one generates a whole world for free 🗺️

✅ One click builds continents, rivers, kingdoms, cultures, religions and cities
✅ Edit anything: reshape the land, rename states, move cities
✅ Switch between political, biome and heightmap views
✅ Export your map as PNG, SVG or JPEG

💻 Any browser · Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ It generates the map for you and the look is its own (not Inkarnate's hand-painted art), so there are lots of buttons to learn. Inkarnate also has a free tier with 3 maps; its paid Creator plan is $39.99/year or $7.99/month

Comment "WORLD" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
